# routeros_interface_ethernet_switch_qos_map_ip (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_interface_ethernet_switch_qos_map_ip" "ip" {
  comment  = "Managed by OpenTofu"
  disabled = true
  dscp     = 1
}
```
